reviewed_clauses.verbatim_extracted_text:
To facilitate and accelerate regulatory processes and activities with the use of information from

approved stringent and well-resourced NRAs while retaining the LMHRA’s regulatory
responsibilities and decision-making autonomy. The decision to practice reliance shall take into
consideration the existing capacities and regulatory systems’ needs of the LMHRA. Depending on
the availability of an authority and access to their information, LMHRA can rely upon any national
or international authority or organisation with confidence and weigh how reliance can complement

LMHRAs capacities to drive efficiencies and the optimal use of resources.
The purpose of the reliance policy is to:

= specify regulatory procedures to complement the regulatory framework and the national
legislation on reliance and recognition.

= enable collaboration with other authorities.

= enable work-sharing (for example, through regional networks); and

= enable reliance on decisions from other regulatory authorities and laboratories and

international organizations (as WHO, PICs, EMA etc).

3.4 Scope
The scope of this Reliance policy shall be applicable to the regulatory oversight of medicinal

products for human and veterinary use (including vaccines and medical devices) encompassing all

regulatory functions spanning the full life cycle of a medicinal product in Liberia.
